name: A Bloodstained Journal Page
summary: During the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle, Commander Althea Ebonlocke has a torn, bloodstained journal page examined. A few words remain legible, so she asks Clerk Daltry to compare its handwriting with the Town Registry.

sections.title: A Grim Piece of Evidence
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke watches over Darkshire and asks for the handwriting on a torn, bloodstained page to be examined. Thick blood covers it, but a few words remain legible. Clerk Daltry is asked to compare them with the Town Registry.

sections.title: Handwriting and Guilt
sections.body: Clerk Daltry keeps the registry in Darkshire's Town Hall. Years of archiving signatures have taught him local handwriting. He compares the page with municipal records and confirms Stalvan wrote it. The tutor's guilt is beyond doubt.

faq.q: What is this bloodstained journal page?
faq.answer: The torn, bloodstained journal page is being examined in the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. Commander Althea Ebonlocke asks Clerk Daltry to check its handwriting.

faq.q: Who can confirm who wrote this page?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry in Darkshire's Town Hall can confirm who wrote the page. He keeps the town registry and compares the writing with old signatures to verify Stalvan's hand.

faq.q: Why does Althea Ebonlocke need this page examined?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke has watched Stalvan for some time. She wants Clerk Daltry to compare the page with the Town Registry and learn whether both were written by the same hand.

faq.q: Where does this page lead in the investigation?
faq.answer: The page goes to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire for comparison with the registry. After he examines its handwriting, the investigation continues with Commander Ebonlocke.

angles.text: As a protector of the realm, you can see Darkshire's Night Watch examining this grim document as evidence in the investigation.
